pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
At the end of an exhausted day, in the collapsing darkness,
It seeps in like starlight, without a single word.
The tiny trace left by fingertips that barely brushed past—
It still echoes deep inside my heart.

[Pre-Chorus]
It still shines inside my memories,
Yet it reaches nowhere, trapped.
Within the cracks of frozen time,
I wander endlessly, searching for you.

[Chorus]
The more I try to erase it, the clearer it becomes—
Your voice, the sound of your breath.
No matter how much I call, you never answer.
Even once would be enough— I want to meet you again.

[Verse 2]
Even in a single line of wind, your scent overlaps me.
Your smile returns, and my chest crumbles again.
No matter how hard I try, it won’t disappear.
I collapse again and again, endlessly.

[Pre-Chorus]
If I can’t ever return to you,
Then at least— hold my hand in my dreams.
Even that warmth alone, I want to breathe it in.
So I can live again.

[Chorus]
A world without you has lost its color,
You left without even a goodbye.
Thorns pierce through my heart like a stab,
And you ache even more inside me.

[Bridge]
I couldn’t even say the words “I love you.”
Only my heart is tied, locked up in the sky.
Where should I stand now, alone?
Please— just once, come back to me.

[Final Chorus]
Everything has already collapsed.
Even in dreams, I go searching for you.
I can’t hold you, but I can’t stop either.
If you don’t exist anywhere,
Then take me with you too—
Anywhere you go.
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.

pkg.youtubeDescription:
✨ "Days That Crumbled" opens at the end of an exhausted day, where starlight slips wordlessly into collapsing darkness and a single brushed fingertip still echoes deep inside the heart.

💔 The more you try to erase it, the clearer it becomes—your voice, your breath, your smile on a single line of wind—until the chest crumbles again and again. This song lives inside that endless falling, the desperate wish to meet just once more, even if only in a dream.

🌙 Soft, emotional POP Original Song with warm male-female duet vocals carries unfinished love and a world that lost its color after goodbye. Controlled, modern, and quietly devastating, it stays long after the final calm note.

💬 Starlight, tell us in the comments—have you ever searched for someone in your dreams because the real world felt too empty without them? We read every word.

#AIArtistNoa #OriginalSong #POP
